question: Who among the following has won the BBC Sports Personality of the Year 2020 award?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Lewis Hamilton.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lewis Hamilton**, the** reigning Formula 1 world champion, **was selected as the **BBC Sports Personality of the Year 2020.**
 
• He had already received the **honor in 2014.**
 
• With his** fourth straight title in 2020,** he **tied Michael Schumacher's** record of **seven world championships,** making him one of** F1's all-time greatest drivers.**
 
• He also surpassed **Schumacher's total of 91 grand prix wins.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• **Emma Raducanu** won the title of **BBC Sports Personality **of the **Year in 2021**. 
 
• She is a British professional tennis player. ** **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Michael Schumacher:**

 
 
• He is a **former Formula One racer** from **Germany** who drove for teams like **Jordan, Benetton, Ferrari, and Mercedes.**
 
 
 
• **Tyson Fury:**
 
 
• He is a** British professional boxer.**
 
 
 
• **Jordan Henderson:**
 
 
• He is a** professional footballer from England** who competes for both the **England national team and Premier League club Liverpool** as a midfielder.
